messages.text:
This needs one more adaptation: layout-1 does not yet have the same level of envelope prototyping: service and cooling space for Si-W EM such as the routing through the HCAL is not defined, similar eventual FCAL envelopes are missing.
Bring them en par with an additional PR, then update the overview document (and PR) you are currently drafting.

I’ll add a separate PR for LAYOUT-001’s service, cooling and forward envelope reservations, then update the reviewer overview and its PDF to match. I’ll first check the current layout inputs and component PRs so the new allocations stay consistent with the Si-W prototypes.

I’m using the repository’s coordination and evidence-review workflow again. The Si-W cassettes already model local pipes and electronics, but their external collectors and routes are excluded. I’ll size those reservations from the existing continuous-power case and make the HCAL interfaces and empty forward reservations explicit. A separate SysArch assessment will check the proposed arrangement.

A workable route can keep the ECAL positions unchanged: an annulus outside the Si-W corners carries services along the inside of the HCAL barrel, and a larger rear barrel/endcap gap lets them turn outward. The current 30 mm ECAL front seam would remain an installation gap.

The packing study also found that a 700 mm-wide lane is too small for the adverse cable case. A 900 × 150 mm lane fits within each of the sixteen sectors, including the proposed clearances.

The Si-W proposal now includes a 300 mm service annulus, a 400 mm rear HCAL gap for outward routing, and an empty FCal reservation behind the existing ECAL endcap. The local heat case remains about 259 kW, requiring an ideal 12.414 kg/s water flow at a 5 K rise. The collector connections, pressure drop and support loads remain open engineering work.

[PR #76](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/76) now contains the Si-W envelope proposal. The updated overview still fits four pages and shows service and forward reservations for both candidates. Its comparison uses the enlarged Si-W HCAL outline: the LAr HCAL envelope volume is now about 1.43 times larger.

CI caught a report-reproduction failure on the new branch. I’m checking the difference before publishing the final overview update.

The review found and resolved a feed-budget inconsistency: the endcap cable inventory used a 12 m route, while its voltage-drop calculation used a 40 m loop. Both now use the same 12 m one-way / 24 m return-loop basis.

The corrected envelope tests and report replay have passed on Linux. I’m finishing the records and publishing the matched overview text and PDF, with #76 preceding #75 for review.
